issue.title: Predictive completion not working with cobra-generated completion scripts
issue.body:
Description:

The [CompletionPredictor](https://github.com/PowerShell/CompletionPredictor) module for PowerShell provides predictive command completion based on previous commands entered in the PowerShell console. However, it does not seem to work with completion scripts generated by the cobra library. When the CompletionPredictor module is imported and enabled, and a cobra-generated completion script is executed, predictive completion does not work for commands that use the completion script.

Steps to reproduce:

Import the [CompletionPredictor](https://github.com/PowerShell/CompletionPredictor) module with Import-Module -Name CompletionPredictor
Set the PredictionSource option to HistoryAndPlugin with Set-PSReadLineOption -PredictionSource HistoryAndPlugin
Generate and execute a cobra-generated completion script (e.g., kubectl completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression)
Type a command that uses the completion script (e.g., kubectl get pods) and try to use predictive completion.
Expected behavior: Predictive completion should work for commands that use cobra-generated completion scripts after importing the CompletionPredictor module and generating the script.

Actual behavior: Predictive completion does not work for commands that use cobra-generated completion scripts.

comments.author: marckhouzam
comments.body:
I don't know how this completion predictor works but if it expects an exhaustive list of possible completions like some scripts provide, it will not work with Cobra.

For Cobra all completions are dynamically generated by calling the actually program providing it with current command-line arguments.
